checks.independentRpc: Receipt/logs, canonical block, both stored orders/CPP/preapproval states, allowance, buyer ETH/USDC PASS

preparedTransaction.gasCaveat: Refresh MetaMask gas and total fee including Base L1 data fee. Routed envelope gas can differ.

directSimulation.label: Actual current buyer account direct collector call

routedSimulation.label: Actual current MetaMask v1.3.0 delegated buyer self-execution; no overrides

routingLimitations: No state or code overrides used; actual current delegation proves payer identity, exact event and post-state under direct collector and delegated self-execution paths. Does not validate an unknown relayer/signature envelope, account upgrade consent, or wallet-local requests. A successful outer receipt alone is insufficient. Require actual collector PaymentPreApproved for exact hash plus isPreApproved=true and unchanged unfunded order, balances and allowance after manual execution.
